title: Product
description: A thing a maker sells or offers under a name: an app, an agent, a feature, a platform, a service. It is not a model, even when it runs on one or shares its brand.
x-description-zh-CN: 出品方以某个名字销售或提供的东西：应用、智能体、功能、平台、服务。即使它跑在某个模型上、或与模型同名，也不是模型。

product_id.description: Stable id of the product: product:<maker>:<name>.
product_id.x-description-zh-CN: 产品的固定编号：product:<出品方>:<名称>。

org_id.description: The maker, when it is in the registry.
org_id.x-description-zh-CN: 出品方；在名单里时填写。

owner_name.description: The maker as the source writes it, for a maker outside the registry.
owner_name.x-description-zh-CN: 来源里写的出品方名称，用于名单之外的出品方。

name.description: The name the maker gives the product.
name.x-description-zh-CN: 出品方给产品起的名字。

category.description: A few plain words for what kind of product it is.
category.x-description-zh-CN: 用几个白话词说明是哪类产品。

created_at.description: When the product was first recorded here.
created_at.x-description-zh-CN: 这里第一次记录该产品的时间。
